<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Sachin Kumar Portfolio</title>
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: deep-black space theme, violet-to-cyan gradient accent (same palette family as the reference), photo hero with orbit ring, tool-logo strip, slider for projects. */
:root{
  --bg:#05050a;
  --bg2:#08080f;
  --card:#0b0b14;
  --card2:#10101c;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.08);
  --fg:#f2f2f8;
  --mute:#8d8da6;
  --v:#8b5cf6;
  --v2:#6d4ae8;
  --c:#38bdf8;
  --grad:linear-gradient(90deg,#7c4dff,#38bdf8);
  --display:'Space Grotesk','Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --body:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,Consolas,monospace;
  color-scheme:dark;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:80px}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:var(--body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.65;margin:0;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));overflow-x:hidden}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:60;background:var(--bg)}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
h1,h2,h3,h4,p{margin:0}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--display);line-height:1.12;text-wrap:balance}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--c);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:4px}
.wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto}
.g{background:var(--grad);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.eyebrow{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.82rem;color:var(--c)}
.sec{padding-block:100px;position:relative}
.sec h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4.8vw,3.2rem);font-weight:600;margin-top:10px}
.lead{color:var(--mute);margin-top:16px;max-width:60ch}
.full{margin-inline:calc(-1*max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)));padding-inline:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px))}
#space{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;z-index:0;pointer-events:none}
main,header,footer,.marq{position:relative;z-index:1}

/* loader */
#loader{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:var(--bg);display:grid;place-items:center;animation:out .6s ease 1.3s forwards}
#loader .in{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:16px}
#loader svg{width:92px;height:92px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 22px rgba(124,77,255,.7))}
#loader .nm{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.3em;font-size:1.05rem;color:#a78bfa}
#loader .pb{width:220px;height:3px;background:var(--line);overflow:hidden;border-radius:3px}
#loader .pb::after{content:"";display:block;height:100%;background:var(--grad);animation:ld 1.2s ease forwards}
#loader small{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.72rem;color:var(--c)}
@keyframes ld{from{transform:translateX(-100%)}to{transform:none}}
@keyframes out{to{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}}
.orb{transform-origin:50% 50%;animation:spin 6s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
#bar{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;height:3px;width:0;background:var(--grad);z-index:90}

/* header */
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:50;margin-inline:calc(-1*max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)));padding-inline:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));border-bottom:1px solid transparent;transition:background .3s,border-color .3s}
header.solid{background:rgba(5,5,10,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);border-color:var(--line)}
.nav{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;height:72px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.95rem}
.logo svg{width:38px;height:38px}
.links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:30px}
.links a{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--mute);position:relative;transition:color .2s}
.links a:not(.btn)::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-6px;height:2px;width:0;background:var(--grad);transition:width .3s}
.links a:hover,.links a.on{color:var(--fg)}
.links a:hover::after,.links a.on::after{width:100%}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;padding:13px 26px;font:600 .9rem/1 var(--body);border-radius:99px;border:1px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;background:var(--grad);transition:transform .25s,box-shadow .25s}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 10px 30px -8px rgba(124,77,255,.7)}
.btn.ghost{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border-color:var(--line)}
.btn.ghost:hover{border-color:var(--c);box-shadow:none}
.links .btn{padding:10px 20px;font-size:.85rem;color:#fff}
.burger{display:none;width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;position:relative;z-index:80}
.burger span{position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;height:2px;background:var(--fg);transition:transform .35s,top .35s,opacity .2s}
.burger span:nth-child(1){top:16px}.burger span:nth-child(2){top:21px}.burger span:nth-child(3){top:26px}
.menu-open .burger span:nth-child(1){top:21px;transform:rotate(45deg)}
.menu-open .burger span:nth-child(2){opacity:0}
.menu-open .burger span:nth-child(3){top:21px;transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.drawer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:55;background:radial-gradient(circle at 85% 8%,rgba(124,77,255,.35),transparent 55%),var(--bg);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:90px max(24px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)) 40px;clip-path:circle(0 at calc(100% - 40px) 40px);visibility:hidden;transition:clip-path .7s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1),visibility 0s .7s}
.menu-open .drawer{clip-path:circle(150% at calc(100% - 40px) 40px);visibility:visible;transition:clip-path .7s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1)}
.drawer a.item{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:16px;font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(2rem,9vw,3rem);font-weight:600;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .4s,transform .4s}
.drawer a.item small{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--c);font-weight:400}
.menu-open .drawer a.item{opacity:1;transform:none}
.menu-open .drawer a.item:nth-child(1){transition-delay:.25s}.menu-open .drawer a.item:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.31s}.menu-open .drawer a.item:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.37s}.menu-open .drawer a.item:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.43s}.menu-open .drawer a.item:nth-child(5){transition-delay:.49s}.menu-open .drawer a.item:nth-child(6){transition-delay:.55s}.menu-open .drawer a.item:nth-child(7){transition-delay:.61s}
.drawer .meta{margin-top:30px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.8rem;color:var(--mute)}
body.menu-open{overflow:hidden}
.menu-open header{z-index:70;background:transparent!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none;backdrop-filter:none;border-color:transparent!important}

/* hero */
.hero{margin-top:-72px;padding-top:72px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;background:radial-gradient(900px 520px at 82% -6%,rgba(124,77,255,.42),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(600px 400px at 0% 100%,rgba(56,189,248,.12),transparent 60%)}
.glow{position:absolute;width:560px;height:560px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(124,77,255,.2),transparent 65%);pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);left:60%;top:40%;transition:left .3s ease-out,top .3s ease-out}
.hero-in{position:relative;max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;align-items:center;min-height:680px;gap:20px}
.pill{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.78rem;padding:7px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:99px;color:var(--mute);background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.pill i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#34d399;animation:ping 2s infinite}
@keyframes ping{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(52,211,153,.6)}70%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(52,211,153,0)}}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.7rem,6.4vw,5rem);font-weight:500;margin-top:24px;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.hero h1 b{font-weight:700;display:block}
.role{margin-top:16px;font-size:clamp(1.1rem,2.2vw,1.45rem);color:var(--mute);min-height:1.7em}
.role span{color:var(--fg)}
.role::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1.1em;background:var(--c);margin-left:4px;vertical-align:-3px;animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}
.hero p.sub{margin-top:16px;color:var(--mute);max-width:48ch}
.cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;margin-top:32px}
.stats{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:40px;margin-top:44px}
.stats b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-size:2.1rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.1}
.stats span{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--mute)}
.portrait{position:relative;align-self:stretch;min-height:540px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.ring{position:absolute;width:min(470px,92%);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:conic-gradient(from 0deg,transparent 0 55%,#7c4dff,#38bdf8,transparent 95%);-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(farthest-side,transparent calc(100% - 3px),#000 calc(100% - 2px));mask:radial-gradient(farthest-side,transparent calc(100% - 3px),#000 calc(100% - 2px));animation:spin 8s linear infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(124,77,255,.8))}
.ph{position:relative;width:min(560px,112%);aspect-ratio:1;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#7b61ff 0%,#171040 75%);-webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 48%,#000 36%,transparent 66%);mask-image:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 48%,#000 36%,transparent 66%)}
.ph img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:45% 32%;mix-blend-mode:multiply;filter:contrast(1.1) saturate(.9) brightness(1.08)}
.panel b{display:block;font:600 1.15rem var(--display);color:var(--fg)}
.panel{position:absolute;font-family:var(--body);font-size:.8rem;background:rgba(8,8,16,.82);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 14px;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);animation:float 6s ease-in-out infinite;color:var(--mute);line-height:1.7}
.panel em{color:var(--c);font-style:normal}.panel u{color:#a78bfa;text-decoration:none}
.p1{left:0;top:16%}.p2{right:0;bottom:16%;animation-delay:-3s}
.eq{display:flex;gap:3px;align-items:flex-end;height:22px;margin-top:6px}
.eq i{flex:1;background:var(--grad);border-radius:2px;animation:eq 1.2s ease-in-out infinite}
.eq i:nth-child(2n){animation-delay:-.4s}.eq i:nth-child(3n){animation-delay:-.8s}
@keyframes eq{0%,100%{height:25%}50%{height:100%}}
@keyframes float{50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}

/* tool strip */
.marq{overflow:hidden;margin-inline:calc(-1*max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px)));border-block:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(8,8,15,.8)}
.marq>div{display:flex;width:max-content;padding:22px 0;animation:mq 46s linear infinite}
.marq:hover>div{animation-play-state:paused}
@keyframes mq{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
.tool{flex:none;width:56px;height:56px;margin-right:18px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--card2);border:1px solid var(--line);font-family:var(--display);font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;transition:transform .25s,border-color .25s}
.tool:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:var(--v)}
.tool svg{width:28px;height:28px}

/* about */
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:24px;margin-top:40px}
.cardx{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:28px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.cardx h3{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:600;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.cardx h3 i{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:8px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(124,77,255,.16);color:#a78bfa;font-style:normal;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.8rem}
.cardx p{color:var(--mute)}
.cardx p b{color:var(--fg);font-weight:500}
.pills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:22px}
.pills span{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:.88rem;padding:10px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.pills span::before{content:"✓";color:#34d399;font-weight:700}
.code{padding:0;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.82rem}
.code .top{display:flex;gap:7px;padding:13px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);align-items:center}
.code .top i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%}
.code .top i:nth-child(1){background:#ff5f57}.code .top i:nth-child(2){background:#febc2e}.code .top i:nth-child(3){background:#28c840}
.code .top span{margin-left:8px;color:var(--mute);font-size:.74rem}
.code pre{margin:0;padding:20px;overflow-x:auto;line-height:1.85;color:#b9b9d0}
.k{color:#7dd3fc}.s{color:#a7f3d0}.n{color:#fbbf77}.o{color:#c4b5fd}
.deliver{grid-column:1/-1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:4px}
.dv{padding:20px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:var(--card);transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s}
.dv:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:rgba(139,92,246,.6)}
.dv b{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px}
.dv span{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--mute)}

/* skills */
.skills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:40px}
/* projects slider */
.work-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.arrows{display:flex;gap:10px}
.arrows button{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--fg);font-size:1.1rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s}
.arrows button:hover{border-color:var(--v);background:var(--v2)}
/* website mockups */
.shot{display:block;position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;overflow:hidden;background:var(--sbg)}
.shot .bar{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:26px;z-index:3;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:0 10px;background:rgba(10,10,20,.88);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.62rem;color:#a5a5bd}
.shot .bar i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#44445c}
.shot .bar span{margin-left:8px;padding:2px 12px;border-radius:99px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.site{position:absolute;inset:26px 0 0 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;color:var(--st,#fff);transition:transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.2,1)}
.slide:hover .site{transform:translateY(-8%)}
.sn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:7px 12px;font:700 .58rem var(--display);letter-spacing:.08em;background:var(--snav,transparent)}
.sn em{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--a);font-style:normal}
.sn s{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:7px}
.sn s i{width:20px;height:3px;background:currentColor;opacity:.4;border-radius:2px}
.sn s u{width:30px;height:11px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--a);opacity:1}
.sh{flex:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:10px;padding:8px 12px 12px;align-items:center}
.sh h4{font:700 clamp(.95rem,2vw,1.35rem)/1.05 var(--display);max-width:11ch}
.sh .l{height:4px;border-radius:3px;background:currentColor;opacity:.35;margin-top:7px;width:80%}
.sh .l+.l{width:55%}
.sh .b{display:inline-block;margin-top:10px;height:13px;width:48px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--a)}
.sh .img{align-self:stretch;margin-block:4px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--a),var(--b));position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.sh .img::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:70%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;right:-15%;bottom:-25%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.sh .img::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:12%;top:14%;width:34%;height:22%;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.sh.dk .img{border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto;width:78%;aspect-ratio:1;height:auto;align-self:center;box-shadow:0 0 40px var(--a)}
.sh.dk .img::before,.sh.dk .img::after{display:none}
.grid4{flex:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px;padding:0 12px 12px}
.grid4 i{border-radius:7px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--a),var(--b));position:relative}
.grid4 i:nth-child(2n){background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--b),var(--a))}
.grid4 i::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:8%;right:30%;bottom:9%;height:4px;border-radius:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
.ban{margin:2px 12px 8px;height:34%;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(100deg,var(--a),var(--b));display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 14px;font:700 clamp(.9rem,2vw,1.2rem)/1 var(--display);color:#fff}

/* journey */
.journey{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:24px;margin-top:40px}
.tl{display:grid;gap:18px;position:relative}
.tl article{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:24px 26px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.tl article::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;background:var(--grad)}
.tl time{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.76rem;color:var(--c)}
.tl h3{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:600;margin-top:4px}
.tl h4{font:500 .92rem var(--body);color:#a78bfa;margin:2px 0 8px}
.tl p{color:var(--mute);font-size:.94rem}
.side{display:grid;gap:18px;align-content:start}
.side ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:grid;gap:8px;color:var(--mute);font-size:.94rem}
.side li::before{content:"→ ";color:var(--v)}
.lang{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.lang span{padding:8px 16px;border-radius:99px;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.88rem}

/* contact */
.contact{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;padding:clamp(28px,6vw,72px);background:radial-gradient(600px 300px at 50% 0%,rgba(124,77,255,.28),transparent 70%),var(--card);text-align:center}
.contact h2{margin-inline:auto;max-width:18ch}
.contact .lead{margin-inline:auto}
.cgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px;margin:38px auto 0;max-width:760px;text-align:left}
.cc{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:16px 18px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(5,5,10,.6);transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s;min-width:0}
.cc:hover{border-color:var(--v);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.cc>i{flex:none;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(124,77,255,.16);display:grid;place-items:center;font-style:normal;color:#a78bfa;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.8rem}
.cc div{flex:1;min-width:0}
.cc small{display:block;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mute)}
.cc div span{overflow-wrap:anywhere;font-size:.94rem}
.cc button{flex:none;font:500 .74rem var(--mono);padding:7px 11px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;color:var(--fg);border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}
.cc button:hover{border-color:var(--c);color:var(--c)}
.cc.wide{grid-column:1/-1}
.contact .btn{margin-top:34px}
footer{max-width:1180px;margin:70px auto 0;padding-block:32px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:var(--mute);font-size:.85rem}
#top{position:fixed;right:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));bottom:max(18px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:40;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:var(--grad);color:#fff;font-size:1.1rem;cursor:pointer;opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);pointer-events:none;transition:all .3s}
#top.show{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}

.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(34px);transition:opacity .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);transition-delay:calc(var(--d,0)*1ms)}
.rv.in,.noanim .rv{opacity:1;transform:none}

@media (max-width:980px){
  .links{display:none}.burger{display:block}
  .hero-in{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:0;padding-bottom:64px}
  .portrait{order:-1;min-height:380px}
  .ph{width:min(440px,100%)}
  .about,.journey{grid-template-columns:1fr}

.ab{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr;gap:56px;margin-top:44px;align-items:center}

.bd b{display:block;font:600 1.5rem var(--display);color:var(--fg);line-height:1.1}
.b1{left:-16px;bottom:14%}.b2{right:-16px;top:10%}

@media (max-width:980px){.ab{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:40px}.abph{margin-inline:auto}.b1{left:8px}.b2{right:8px}}

/* hero floating card */
.p2{padding:14px 16px;min-width:210px}
.p2 .pf{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:600 .88rem var(--display);color:var(--fg)}
.p2 .pf i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#34d399;animation:ping 2s infinite}
.stk{display:flex;margin:12px 0 10px}
.stk span{flex:none;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--card2);border:2px solid #0b0b16;display:grid;place-items:center;margin-left:-9px;font:700 .62rem var(--display);position:relative;transition:transform .25s}
.stk span:first-child{margin-left:0}

/* process */
.flow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:72px;position:relative}
.fst{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
.fst:not(:last-child)::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:33px;left:calc(50% + 46px);width:calc(100% + 18px - 92px);height:0;border-top:2px dashed rgba(139,92,246,.55)}
.fn{width:68px;height:68px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;z-index:2;color:#c4b5fd;border:2px solid transparent;background:linear-gradient(var(--bg),var(--bg)) padding-box,var(--grad) border-box;box-shadow:0 0 28px -4px rgba(124,77,255,.55);transition:transform .35s,box-shadow .35s}
.fn svg{width:28px;height:28px}
.fc{position:relative;overflow:hidden;width:100%;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin-top:20px;padding:28px 22px 22px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(20,18,38,.9),var(--card));text-align:center;transition:transform .35s,border-color .35s}
.fc small{display:block;font:500 .72rem var(--mono);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c)}
.fc b{display:block;font:600 1.35rem var(--display);margin:6px 0 8px}
.fc span{display:block;color:var(--mute);font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.55}
.fx{margin-top:auto;min-height:122px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.12);font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.55;color:#b9b9d0}
.fc{gap:0}.fc>span{margin-bottom:20px}

.fst:hover .fc{transform:translateY(-6px);border-color:rgba(139,92,246,.55)}
.fst:hover .fn{transform:scale(1.08);box-shadow:0 0 40px 0 rgba(124,77,255,.8)}

/* skills */
.skills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:20px;margin-top:40px}
.sk{padding:26px 26px 28px;transition:border-color .3s,transform .3s}
.sk::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0 0 auto;height:2px;background:var(--grad);opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.sk:hover{border-color:rgba(139,92,246,.45);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.sk:hover::before{opacity:1}
.skh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:22px}
.skh .ic{flex:none;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#c4b5fd;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(124,77,255,.3),rgba(56,189,248,.14));border:1px solid rgba(139,92,246,.38)}
.skh .ic svg{width:23px;height:23px}

.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.chips>.sc{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-size:.88rem;padding:6px 14px 6px 6px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.025);transition:border-color .25s,transform .25s,background .25s}
.chips>.sc:hover{border-color:var(--v);transform:translateY(-2px);background:rgba(124,77,255,.1)}
.sc .ti{flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);color:var(--c);font:700 .68rem var(--display)}
.sc .ti svg{width:17px;height:17px}

/* projects showcase */
.show{margin-top:48px;overflow-x:clip}
.stage{display:grid}
.fs2{grid-area:1/1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.45fr .75fr;gap:52px;align-items:center;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transform:translateX(var(--off,40px));transition:opacity .55s,transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),visibility 0s .7s}
.fs2.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:none;transition:opacity .6s .1s,transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),visibility 0s}
.fwrap{position:relative;min-width:0}
.fwrap::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:10% 4% -8%;background:var(--a);filter:blur(80px);opacity:.3;border-radius:50%}
.fwrap .shot{position:relative;z-index:1;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);box-shadow:0 30px 70px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.9);transition:transform .5s}
.fs2:hover .fwrap .shot{transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.01)}
.shot img{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:26px;width:100%;height:calc(100% - 26px);object-fit:cover;object-position:top}
.fs2:hover .site{transform:translateY(-8%)}
.fi{min-width:0}
.fi .num{font:400 .82rem var(--mono);color:var(--mute)}
.fi .num b{font-weight:500;color:var(--fg);font-size:1.5rem;font-family:var(--display)}

.thumbs{position:relative;display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:48px;overflow-x:auto;padding:4px 2px 8px;scrollbar-width:none}

.thumb{flex:0 0 clamp(170px,19%,210px);position:relative;overflow:hidden;text-align:left;padding:14px 16px 16px;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--fg);font:inherit;cursor:pointer;opacity:.6;transition:opacity .3s,border-color .3s,transform .3s}

.noauto .thumb.on i{animation:none;width:100%}
@keyframes fill{to{width:100%}}
.note{text-align:center;color:var(--mute);margin:22px auto 0;max-width:56ch;font-size:.92rem}

.ft{position:sticky;top:110px}
.fq{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--card);margin-bottom:12px;transition:border-color .3s,background .3s}
.fq:hover{border-color:rgba(139,92,246,.35)}

.fq>button{width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;text-align:left;padding:20px 22px;background:none;border:0;color:var(--fg);font:600 1.02rem/1.4 var(--display);cursor:pointer;border-radius:14px}
.fq .n{flex:none;font:400 .74rem var(--mono);color:var(--c)}
.fq .t{flex:1}
.pl{flex:none;width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);position:relative;color:var(--fg);transition:background .3s,border-color .3s,color .3s}
.pl::before,.pl::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:12px;height:2px;background:currentColor;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);transition:transform .35s}
.pl::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(90deg)}
.fq.open .pl{background:var(--grad);border-color:transparent;color:#fff}
.fq.open .pl::after{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(0)}
.fa{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .4s ease}

  }
  if (reduce || !('IntersectionObserver' in window)) {
    $('body').addClass('noanim'); $('[data-n]').each(function () { $(this).text($(this).data('n') + ($(this).data('s') || '')); });
  } else {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) { es.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) { $(e.target).addClass('in'); io.unobserve(e.target); } }); }, { threshold: .12 });
    $('.rv').each(function () { io.observe(this); });
    var cio = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) { es.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) { count($(e.target)); cio.unobserve(e.target); } }); }, { threshold: .5 });
    $('[data-n]').each(function () { cio.observe(this); });
    setTimeout(function () { $('.rv').addClass('in'); }, 4000);
  }

  $('#home').on('mousemove', function (e) { var r = this.getBoundingClientRect(); $('#glow').css({ left: e.clientX - r.left, top: e.clientY - r.top }); });

  /* starfield */
  var cv = document.getElementById('space'), cx = cv.getContext('2d'), st = [], W, H;
  function size() {
    var d = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2); W = window.innerWidth; H = window.innerHeight;
    cv.width = W * d; cv.height = H * d; cx.setTransform(d, 0, 0, d, 0, 0);
    st = []; for (var i = 0; i < Math.min(120, W * H / 11000); i++) st.push({ x: Math.random() * W, y: Math.random() * H, r: Math.random() * 1.3 + .3, s: Math.random() * .25 + .05, p: Math.random() * 6 });
  }
  function draw(t) {
    cx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
    for (var i = 0; i < st.length; i++) {
      var s = st[i]; s.y -= s.s; if (s.y < -2) { s.y = H + 2; s.x = Math.random() * W; }
      cx.globalAlpha = .35 + .5 * Math.abs(Math.sin(s.p + t / 1500));
      cx.fillStyle = i % 5 ? '#c9c2ff' : '#7dd3fc'; cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, 6.3); cx.fill();
    }
    if (!reduce) requestAnimationFrame(draw);
  }
  size(); requestAnimationFrame(draw); $(window).on('resize', size);

  /* copy */
  $('[data-copy]').on('click', function () {
    var b = this, v = $(b).data('copy');
    function ok() { b.textContent = 'Copied'; setTimeout(function () { b.textContent = 'Copy'; }, 1500); }
    function fb() { var t = document.createElement('textarea'); t.value = v; document.body.appendChild(t); t.select(); try { document.execCommand('copy'); ok(); } catch (e) {} document.body.removeChild(t); }
    if (navigator.clipboard) navigator.clipboard.writeText(v).then(ok, fb); else fb();
  });
  $('#yr').text(new Date().getFullYear());
});
</script>


</body>
</html>
